title: AuthorityRef
description: Source of truth: doorway operational session state (Operational, Category C). Human-readable authority reference surfaced by the portal trust-indicator chrome — for doorway-host mode the label is the doorway hostname and id is the doorway_id slug; for peer-conductor mode they describe the peer's conductor location. Rust wire authority: doorway/doorway-service/src/routes/auth_routes.rs AuthorityRef (validated by that crate's tests/schema_contract.rs).

label.description: Human-readable label rendered by the trust-indicator chip

id.description: Optional stable identifier (doorway_id slug or conductor peer_id). Absent when unknown (serde skip_serializing_if)
